reason: method1 returns the index of the first occurrence of the delimiter character starting from the given offset, treating all characters literally. method2 treats a backslash as an escape character and skips the following character; it only returns the index of the first occurrence of the quoteChar that is not escaped. When the delimiter is the backslash character itself, method1 finds it immediately, whereas method2 never considers a backslash as a match and therefore returns -1.
